perspectives.title: A Chikkamagaluru Mom serving FAMILY RECIPES in Bengaluru ❤️ Details👇 If you’re searching for the best cafes in Indiranagar or a cafe in Bangalore with an actual story behind it, this one feels a little different. Estate Deli is a family-run cafe in Indiranagar built around one mother’s love for cooking, backed by her husband and sons who brought the idea to life together. Their roots go all the way back to Chikkamagaluru, where the family has its own coffee estate, so the coffee you drink here comes straight from home. The kitchen follows the same philosophy too, mixing comforting family recipes with fun cafe favourites. You’ll find Chikkamagaluru inspired dishes like Pashti & Broth and the Heritage Bowl alongside their loaded Chicago Pie Pizza, Texas Chicken Sandwich and some seriously indulgent cakes and desserts. perspectives.author: eat_with_fazi
perspectives.title: 📍 Estate Deli, Indiranagar A little taste of Chikmagalur, right in the heart of Indiranagar ☕️🌿 Estate Deli brings together 5 generations of coffee-growing heritage and recipes inspired by home. From comforting bowls and indulgent Chicago-style pizza to their loaded Texas Chicken Sandwich, there’s plenty to explore. The pour-over was smooth, aromatic and beautifully brewed. But the real surprise? Their Croissant Chocolate Cake — absolutely decadent! Finished with the refreshing Lychee Cherry Cake. If you love good food, coffee and stories with a little soul, Estate Deli is worth a visit. Follow @eat_with_fazi for more such recommendations ✅ No repost without permission ❌

perspectives.title: Bangalore’s hottest vegetarian cafe alert 👀 @thekind.india A pure vegetarian cafe in Indiranagar with an all‑new menu, specialty coffee and legit pizza? The Kind Roastery & Brew Room on 12th Main is exactly where your next weekend plan, date night or family brunch needs to be. From quick cappuccino and strawberry matcha to bakes, Burmese khao suey bowl, sticky spicy tan tan noodles, wild mushroom dim sums on curry and Muhammara with hummus, this veg cafe makes “going out for coffee” feel like a full‑blown restaurant experience. Add mushroom bianco pizza, Roma tomatoes pesto grilled cheese sandwich, simple chocolate cake, Boston cream cake and a rose relish cold drip, and you’ve got one of the best cafes in Bangalore for coffee, pizza and dessert cravings. Indiranagar is already known for the best cafes in Bangalore and The Kind Roastery is on every must visit cafe list for a reason.
